name: Kuna'a
source:
Pronouns: He/They
[spoiler]Occupation: Tenebraun[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Affiliation: Dusk Court[/spoiler]
Age: Unknown

Likes: Constellations, food, a challenge
Dislikes: Excessive pride, violence
Hobbies: Napping, exploring untraveled areas

[spoiler]Specialty: Shadow Manipulation[/spoiler]
Signature Move: Moonlight Essence. Kuna'a is able to tap into the energy and light from the moonlight to make himself invisible and cast casual tricks on his enemies.

[spoiler]A Fae, a being shrouded in mystery, Kuna'a seems to speak only in questions and riddles. He prowls, as if a creature of the night. And, like the shadows, he can shift in and out of sight just as easily. Every time you have met him, you seem to be left only more frustrated.

On your first encounter, he attacked, without warning, his intentions unclear. Since then, you have unsuccessfully received the answers you desire. However, his desire, his need, for your powers is unclear. What situation could be so dire that it has made him stoop to these actions? Are his intentions genuine? Is he well-intentioned?[/spoiler]

[From in-game profile]
